parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Caller-generated key (a UUID per logical submit, 1-128 printable ASCII characters) that makes a retried POST safe (ADR 0019, ADR 0044). Clients MUST always send it: the service runs on Postgres in every deployment (ADR 0039), so the header is always enforced and an absent key is answered 400 `idempotency-key-required`, a malformed one 400 `idempotency-key-invalid`. A replay with the same key, method, path and body returns the original response verbatim plus the response header `Idempotency-Replayed: true`; the same key with a different method, path or body is 409 `idempotency-key-reused`. The key is global (not per route).
